details:
I would argue many avatar authors often make various versions of the same model to include different gimmicks, outfits, or other multiple changes one might make. Segmenting avatars like this has numerous benefits with the main being performance. 
The avatar selection menu as it stands, or even in the new upcoming menu preview, suffers from a lack of organization. (The sort feature in the menu preview is a big step forward) If you're like me sometimes you'll have 2-4 different versions of the same avatar to optimize performance, with the cost of cluttering up your avatar menu with these seemingly duplicate avatars, differentiated only by maybe a slightly different thumbnail or a modified avatar name to indicate the change.
I propose letting the player create custom categories or even just custom groups/folders that would allow a user to group avatars together as they deem necessary, allowing them to potentially group together versions of the same avatar, or group together avatars for specific social functions. Gone would be the day of seeing your avatar list cluttered with avatars that look nearly identical visually to thumbnails/titles. 
You could even take it a step further and allow custom naming of avatars, or some sort of convention that would allow users to give nicknames to avatars that exist in groupings/folders for extra context. For instance, I could have a group/folder in that I include all the permutations of my main avatar (the version with VRLens, the stripped-down version for extra performance for music events with large crowds, and the versions with alternative outfits) and it would be super handy to be able to assign a custom nickname to each one to further distinguish their differences (their nicknames could be VRLens, Med-Quality, Summer Outfit #1 respectively as some loose examples). These nicknames could only visible to the user whose tagged them while the original avatar name remains visible to everyone else.
title: Avatar Menu - Custom Organization/Categories/Grouping
